modern: Let whatever will fall from outside on the parts which can feel the effects of this fall. For those parts which have felt it will complain, if they choose. But I, unless I think that what has happened is an evil, am not harmed. And it is in my power not to think so.
original: Let there fall externally what will on the parts which can feel the effects of this fall. For those parts which have felt will complain, if they choose. But I, unless I think that what has happened is an evil, am not injured. And it is in my power not to think so.
